metadata.latestEvidenceReview: All 22 formerly partial source rows now have targeted value and consumer assertions: redeploy timing, AoE deployment damage, summon stat effects and owner/range boundaries, profession penetration/kill-heal, acquisition economy and battle start/end cross effects. Full combination-space coverage remains open.
metadata.verificationScope: All 90 declared source effect rows: numeric consumers, native triggers, target and lifecycle boundaries, and representative interactions. Full-mode integration and browser delivery are tracked separately in the active plan.
metadata.remainingCombinationScope: Arbitrary cross-relic permutations are not exhaustively enumerated; this finite source-effect closure does not claim exhaustive state-space testing.
